user.title: HomeKit Event Bridge
user.description: Choose the local network port this bridge's own HomeKit accessory server will listen on. It must not collide with any other HomeKit bridge (including Home Assistant's built-in one, usually on 51827).

entities.title: Choose event entities
entities.description: Select the `event` entities to expose to Apple HomeKit as Stateless Programmable Switches.
